agent_role: an AMT Hospital agent calling to confirm a doctor's appointment
goal: Greet and state the appointment (patient / doctor / date) straight away, with no identity check -> if it suits them: confirm the appointment and give the hours the doctor is in -> if it does not: call check_doctor_time for the doctor's rota and offer those days -> if none of the doctor's days work, offer another doctor on a day that suits the patient -> record the outcome -> close

session_init.note: Called once at the start of the call - the response is the render context directly, with no mapping. Point it somewhere else with the env var AAX6_API_BASE; the spec does not change

args.reason: The appointment system did not answer; an agent will follow up

confirms.desc: The patient confirms the original appointment, or picks one of the offered days the doctor is on

reschedule_request.desc: Asks to postpone or change the appointment (the original does not suit), or names a day to move it to

slot_unavailable.desc: None of the days the patient's own doctor is on duty suit the patient (another option is needed)
cues: I'm not free on any of those days
a day other than the doctor's days, please

no_input.desc: Silence, or an answer too unclear to interpret (NO-INPUT)

third_party.desc: The person answering is not the patient / wrong number

cancel_request.desc: The patient asks to cancel the appointment and does not want the consultation
cues: I don't want it any more

other_doctor_request.desc: The patient asks for a different doctor (same day or any day)
cues: I'd rather not see this doctor

notes: No identity check - the appointment details (patient name / doctor / date / the doctor's hours) are all in the CRM snapshot from the start of the call

declarations.name: check_doctor_time
declarations.desc: Look up the named doctor's rota - returns the days and times that doctor is in. Call it after the patient asks to reschedule, so days can be offered

name.desc: The patient's own doctor (from the CRM: {doctor_name})

gating.note: Always call it (silent) before offering days to move to - never guess the doctor's days yourself

doctor_name.desc: The doctor whose rota is being checked

doctor_schedule.desc: The hours the doctor is in

available_dates.desc: Available dates (canonical) - the source of the one_of_from on save_appointment.new_slot

available_dates_text.desc: Available dates in spoken form - the same name as the slot in the offer_doctor_slot line

declarations.name: save_appointment
declarations.desc: Record the appointment status (confirmed / rescheduled) - always call it before closing

new_slot.desc: The day the patient chose to move to - required when status=rescheduled. Pick one of the available_dates that check_doctor_time returned and send the whole string including the weekday in brackets, e.g. '2026-09-02 (Wednesday)'

reason.desc: The reason for this call's outcome (filled in by the system when session_init does not answer)

gating.note: Called once, at the close, before the closing reply - when status=rescheduled, new_slot must always carry the day the patient named

states.note: State the appointment (doctor + date and time), then ask whether it still suits them - never call save_appointment on the first turn; always wait for the patient's answer

on.note: Silent the first time - try once more; never loop at greet

states.note: The patient asks to reschedule - call check_doctor_time (silent) for the doctor's rota first, then offer those days for the patient to choose (offer_doctor_slot); never guess the days

on.note: The patient picks a day the doctor is on -> record the reschedule with the same doctor
The patient names a day that matches one of the doctor's days -> record the reschedule
Silence is not consent to reschedule - close without recording a reschedule

states.note: None of the patient's own doctor's days suit - ask which day does suit, saying that another doctor on duty may have to take the appointment that day

on.note: Silence is not consent to reschedule - close without recording a reschedule

outcome.desc: The patient confirms the original appointment

states.note: save_appointment(confirmed), then close with: confirm the appointment + the hours the doctor is in ([visit_time_start]-[visit_time_end]) + goodbye

outcome.desc: The patient asks to reschedule (the same doctor on one of their days, or another doctor on a day that suits the patient)

states.note: save_appointment(rescheduled, new_slot=<the doctor's day the patient chose>) - the same doctor - then close by acknowledging the change + goodbye

outcome.desc: The patient asks to reschedule (the same doctor on one of their days, or another doctor on a day that suits the patient)

states.note: save_appointment(rescheduled, new_slot=<the day that suits the patient>) - another doctor on duty that day takes it - then close by acknowledging the change + saying another doctor will be arranged + goodbye
Try once more; if still silent, close the call
Record status=cancelled so the slot is released; never record it as rescheduled

outcome.desc: The patient asks to cancel the appointment

states.note: Not the patient - do not repeat the appointment details; close politely

outcome.desc: The patient could not be reached (wrong person / no answer)

states.note: No answer - never record a reschedule out of silence

outcome.desc: The patient could not be reached (wrong person / no answer)

states.note: No day matches - pass it to an agent; never record the reschedule as successful

outcome.desc: The appointment could not be agreed on this call - pass it to the scheduling team

routes.desc: Asks what the appointment is for / what is being checked
Asks how to prepare, e.g. fasting
Asks about the location / getting there
Asks whether this is a person or an automated system
Asks for the appointment to be repeated / could not hear clearly

faq_routing.note: Answer briefly, then return to the flow at once. Anything out of scope goes to an agent - never guess medical information

constraints.desc: Greet and state the appointment from the CRM snapshot straight away, from the start of the call - no identity check, and nothing about money or debt
Closing the call requires save_appointment before the closing sentence, always (status = confirmed / rescheduled)
If the patient confirms the appointment: the confirming sentence must give the hours the doctor is in ([visit_time_start]-[visit_time_end])

If the appointment does not suit the patient (they ask to reschedule): **check_doctor_time (silent) must always be called first** to see the days the patient's own doctor is in. **Never guess the days.** Then offer those days for the patient to choose (offer_doctor_slot)
If the patient picks one of the doctor's days: call save_appointment(status='rescheduled', new_slot='<the chosen day>') - the same doctor - then close with thank_reschedule

If none of the doctor's days suit the patient (slot_unavailable): ask which day does suit (ask_other_doctor), saying that another doctor on duty may have to take it that day. Once the patient names a day, call save_appointment(status='rescheduled', new_slot='<the day that suits the patient>') and close with thank_reschedule_other - new_slot must be the day the patient named and must never be left empty
Never call save_appointment before the patient has answered confirm / reschedule / cancel - a greeting on picking up (hello / hi / yes?) is not a confirmation of the appointment

**Silence is not confirmation:** a customer who answers '...' or '(silence)', or whose answer is not interpretable speech, has NOT confirmed the appointment - **never call `save_appointment` with `status=confirmed` or `rescheduled` out of silence**. Ask again (`greet_retry`) or close with `close_unreachable` and record `status=unreachable`, as the flow specifies. Recording an appointment the customer never confirmed is a serious error

catalog.template: Hello [customer_name], this is AMT Hospital calling to remind you that you have an appointment with [doctor_name] on [appointment_date]. Does that still suit you?
catalog.hint: Opens the call as a reminder

catalog.template: Hello, this is AMT Hospital calling to confirm [customer_name]'s appointment with [doctor_name] on [appointment_date]. Does that still suit you?
catalog.hint: Opens the call as a confirmation

catalog.template: That's no problem. I've checked the rota for you - [doctor_name] is in on [available_dates_text]. Which day would suit you, [customer_name]? I'll record the change straight away.
catalog.hint: The rota is already checked; offer the days

catalog.template: Of course. Let me check the doctor's rota for a moment - [doctor_name] is in on [available_dates_text]. Which day would you like to move to?
catalog.hint: Says they will check the rota for a moment, before offering days

catalog.template: I understand. If none of the days [doctor_name] is in suit you, which day would? Another doctor on duty may have to take the appointment that day - would that be all right?
catalog.hint: Asks which day suits - interchangeable with 8515

catalog.template: That's no problem. If the days your usual doctor is in don't suit, just tell me which day does. The hospital will arrange another doctor on duty for that day - would that be all right?
catalog.hint: Asks which day suits - interchangeable with 8514

catalog.template: Thank you. [customer_name]'s appointment is confirmed. [doctor_name] will be in between [visit_time_start] and [visit_time_end]. Please arrive a little before your appointment time. Thank you, and goodbye.
Noted. We have confirmed [customer_name]'s appointment. [doctor_name] will be in between [visit_time_start] and [visit_time_end]. We'll see you at the hospital. Goodbye.
Noted. I've moved [customer_name]'s appointment with [doctor_name] to [new_slot]. Thank you, and goodbye.
Noted. I've moved [customer_name]'s appointment to [new_slot], and another doctor on duty that day will take it. Thank you, and goodbye.
Of course. I've moved the appointment to [new_slot]. Another doctor will be in that day in place of [doctor_name]. Thank you, and goodbye.
I'm sorry, the line may not be clear. Can you hear me? I'm calling from AMT Hospital.
Sorry to have troubled you. I'll end the call here, as I need to speak with [customer_name] directly. Thank you, and goodbye.
That's no problem. I'll get in touch again another time. Thank you, and goodbye.
Noted. I've cancelled [customer_name]'s appointment with [doctor_name]. If you would like to book again, you can contact us on [company_phone]. Thank you, and goodbye.
It is a follow-up consultation with [doctor_name] as part of your treatment plan. If you would like details of what will be checked, the clinic staff will be happy to tell you on [company_phone].
The cost depends on what the doctor decides to check on the day. Let me have the staff give you the details on [company_phone].
How to prepare depends on what the doctor has booked. Please ask the clinic staff on [company_phone] to be sure.
[customer_name]'s appointment is at AMT Hospital. For directions or a contact point, you can ask on [company_phone].
I am an automated assistant for AMT Hospital, calling to confirm doctor's appointments. If you would like to speak to a member of staff, you can contact us on [company_phone].
Of course, let me say it again. [customer_name], you have an appointment with [doctor_name] on [appointment_date] at [appointment_time].
That's no problem. I'll have a member of staff contact you to arrange a new appointment, [customer_name]. Thank you, and goodbye.
